_doc: Thousandvale-only monsters (docs/EXPANSION-1.md §5). Each row is a new creature: its own id, name, family, level range and look; its combat NUMBERS copy the Farhold bestiary entry named by `base` (js/rules/tv-monsters.js). The client draws `look` (js/client/looks.js) in the same shape as data/monster-looks.json. Names are original — no third-party IP, no 'ember'/'veil'/'muster'.

monsters.name: Scoria Crawler
monsters.desc: A centipede as long as a cart, plated in cooled lava. The seams between its plates still glow.

monsters.name: Ashback Salamander
monsters.desc: Low, broad and black, with a belly the colour of a forge. It basks on hot rock and hates to be moved.

monsters.name: Pumice Golem
monsters.desc: A heap of pale, holed stone that stood up. It floats in the crater lake, and it does not like visitors on the shore.

monsters.name: Vent Wisp
monsters.desc: A twist of yellow steam that rises from the vents with something like a face in it.

monsters.name: Glasswing
monsters.desc: A hunting bird with the body of a great cat and feathers of black glass. Its dive sounds like breaking windows.

monsters.name: Steamwood Prowler
monsters.desc: A tusked jungle cat, mottled green and bronze. You hear the leaves stop moving before you see it.

monsters.name: Sulphur Toad
monsters.desc: As big as a barrel and as yellow as the flats it sits in. It spits.

monsters.name: Obsidian Warden
monsters.desc: A shelled thing of black glass that guards the old kilns. Swords chip on it; it does not chip.

monsters.name: Mudback Lurker
monsters.desc: It lies in the hot mud of the fens with only its back showing, steaming, like a log that breathes.

monsters.name: Slagborn Raider
monsters.desc: The Slagborn were Vharl once. Now they wear the ash, take what the villages grow, and call the volcano mother.

monsters.name: Slagborn Firecaller
monsters.desc: A Slagborn priest who carries a coal in a cage on a chain and talks to it.

monsters.name: Slagborn Chief
monsters.desc: Armoured in plates of cooled slag, with a shield made from a cart door. The raiders do what the chief says.

monsters.name: Ossathra, the Caldera Wyrm
monsters.desc: The island's oldest thing. It sleeps in the crater lake and wakes when the mountain does.

monsters.name: Fallow Deer
monsters.desc: A dappled deer of the downs. It never fights; it only runs — the hounds and hyenas of the open country run it down (a wandering pack's quarry, js/sim/packs.js).

monsters.name: Cinderhorn Goat
monsters.desc: A shaggy grey goat of the Burning Isle with horns gone black at the tips. The prowlers of the steam-woods hunt it (a wandering pack's quarry).
